idea-plugin.name: Global Notes
idea-plugin.description:
Keep persistent notes available across projects directly inside your JetBrains IDE. Global Notes provides a lightweight writing area that saves changes automatically.

  • Create and manage multiple named notes.
  • Select one active note for focused editing.
  • Rename or delete notes from a compact header menu.
  • Use theme-aware colors in light and dark IDE themes.

All note content remains local. The plugin does not require an account or transmit data.
